title: fix(paimon): read catalog options from pypaimon Options objects

files.patch:
@@ -13,6 +13,22 @@
     from pypaimon.table.table import Table as PaimonTable
 
 
+def _get_catalog_options(table: "PaimonTable") -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return the table's catalog options as a plain dict.
+
+    pypaimon >= 1.4.1 exposes ``file_io.properties`` as an ``Options`` object (whose ``get`` takes a
+    ``ConfigOption``) instead of a dict, so normalize it through ``to_map()`` when present.
+    """
+    file_io = getattr(table, "file_io", None)
+    properties = getattr(file_io, "properties", None) if file_io is not None else None
+    if properties is None:
+        return {}
+    to_map = getattr(properties, "to_map", None)
+    if callable(to_map):
+        properties = to_map()
+    return properties or {}
+
+
 def _convert_paimon_catalog_options_to_io_config(catalog_options: dict[str, str]) -> IOConfig | None:
     """Convert pypaimon catalog options to Daft IOConfig.

+
+
+def test_get_catalog_options_accepts_options_object():
+    """Pypaimon >= 1.4.1 exposes file_io.properties as an Options object, not a dict."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from daft.io.paimon._paimon import _get_catalog_options
+
+    class _Options:
+        def __init__(self, data):
+            self.data = data
+
+        def to_map(self):
+            return self.data
+
+        def get(self, key, default=None):
+            return self.data.get(key.key, default)
+
+    options = {"warehouse": "oss://bucket/wh"}
+    assert _get_catalog_options(SimpleNamespace(file_io=SimpleNamespace(properties=_Options(options)))) == options
+    assert _get_catalog_options(SimpleNamespace(file_io=SimpleNamespace(properties=options))) == options
+    assert _get_catalog_options(SimpleNamespace(file_io=SimpleNamespace(properties=None))) == {}
+    assert _get_catalog_options(SimpleNamespace()) == {}
